fix(validator-ata): compile every extra schema the runtime validator uses into the precompiled module (#5571)

* fix(validator-ata): bundle json-schema.org meta-schemas that ata does not ship

* fix(validator-ata): compile a shipped meta-schema id in when the caller's document has its own $vocabulary

* fix(validator-ata): leave an extra meta-schema out only when it equals ata's own copy under the same $id

* fix(validator-ata): decide on the extras the runtime validator ends up with, and keep a shipped copy another extra refers to

* fix(validator-ata): compile in every extra the runtime validator ends up with, and keep the caller's schemas next to the root

* fix(validator-ata): register extras under the $id ata uses, keep the root last and build its list once

* fix(validator-ata): draft-04 id only where read as draft-04, keep boolean entries, leave out fragment-only ids, let the form's own schemas win

* fix(validator-ata): one list of extra schemas for the root, its sub-schemas and the module, read by ata's own draft-04 rules

* Apply batched suggestions from code review

Last round of suggestions, applied
